answer: Require every new agent to stake a small refundable deposit that stays locked until it completes a verified task, creating a ferrous anchor on its identity: a whisper of doubt follows any agent that abandons its stake, and the delta between its deposit and its earnings is forfeited if it is caught faking work. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities must fund a real deposit for each one, so the cost scales with the number of Sybils while honest agents get their stake back.
